description: A man in a feathered headdress and spotted jaguar-skin cloak places his hands on the head of a man in a turquoise and white embroidered mantle wearing a turquoise crown, whose arms are raised. They stand in a stone temple courtyard with carved walls, columns, incense smoke and fire braziers. Kneeling and standing attendants in feathered headdresses and woven garments watch, some with hands pressed together. No visible text, border or frame.
